why: Both share the same jute rug, walnut round table, rice paper lamp and ZZ plant, whose plastic terracotta nursery pot misses the requested ceramic. B's warm oatmeal sofa is closer to the requested beige, sits better with the jute and walnut, and comes with dimensions that fit the right wall. A's cool grey, chunky-armed sofa feels heavier and less serene, though neither sofa is truly low-profile.
